The '''SX-14 Field Hover-Ute''' was a [[Mobquet Swoops and Speeders/Legends|Mobquet Swoops and Speeders]] utility vehicle design.

==History==
The Hover-Ute was used for practical labor assistance by individuals living hard lives, such as [[Owen Lars/Legends|Owen Lars]] on his [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] [[Moisture farm/Legends|moisture farm]]. Owen's hover-ute was equipped with a [[Moisture vaporator/Legends|vaporator]] embedder/extractor, auto-siphon, and insulated water-storage tank. His vehicle also utilized a detachable load carrier.
